subject: Mutual action playbook — stakeholder intros & listing timeline (Stratus Systems)
messages:
From: Claire Mitchell <claire.mitchell@stratussys.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>; vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>; diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2028 11:12:00 -0400
Subject: Mutual action playbook for Stratus listing — roles & 6-week timeline

Hi Hannah / team,

Thanks again for taking the time last week — excited to get the listing work underway. Attaching a first-draft mutual action playbook (MAP) and the marketplace technical checklist so we can align on owners and the target close window. High-level asks:

- Confirm internal owners for procurement, security questionnaire, and listing copy by EOD Friday (2028-06-15).
- Align on a 6-week timeline to published listing (goal: 2028-07-27).
- Schedule a 45-minute ops sync to walk the MAP and open items.

Key stakeholders from our side: myself (Claire) — partner lead, and Rajiv (AWS channel contact) will coordinate the AWS partner ops intake. Elena will be the GCP marketplace contact for packaging.

I proposed an initial RACI in the MAP but left many cells open for your assignments. Two attachments: Stratus-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx and Listing-technical-checklist.pdf.

Proposed meeting windows (ET):
- Wed 2028-06-12 10:00–10:45
- Thu 2028-06-13 14:00–14:45

Please confirm a time that works and add any other Redwood stakeholders we should loop in (legal, product).

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Claire Mitchell
Head of Partnerships | Stratus Systems
claire.mitchell@stratussys.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: Stratus-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Listing-technical-checklist.pdf (pdf)
From: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Mitchell <claire.mitchell@stratussys.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2028 16:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual action playbook for Stratus listing — roles & 6-week timeline

Claire — great to kick this off. Thanks for the clear MAP and checklist. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- Owners (initial):
  - Marketplace ops (AWS): vanessa_ortiz — will interface with Rajiv and own the AWS intake form.
  - GCP packaging + artifacts: marissa_cole — will lead GCP packaging and test listing flow.
  - Security questionnaire / evidence: diego_fernandez — will coordinate SOC2/Security answers and provide audit artifacts.
  - Legal/terms: I will pull in legal once we have the pricing table locked.

- Timeline: 6-week target is reasonable. We prefer a soft milestone cadence: Intake & checklist complete by 2028-06-21, content & artifacts by 2028-07-05, QA & signoffs by 2028-07-20, publish 2028-07-27. If legal needs more lead time we will flag.

- Meeting: Wed 2028-06-12 10:00 ET works for me. Vanessa will send a calendar invite and include the agenda: walk MAP, open dependencies, doc owners, and action items (30 min + 15 min buffer).

I added a few inline notes to the MAP (see Drive link) and will keep the copy iteration to a single source-of-truth doc.

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
+1 (617) 555-0104

Thanks — will take GCP packaging and the artifact checklist. Quick notes: 
- I’ll spin up a packaging sandbox and share access by 2028-06-15.
- We should validate the telemetry hooks (usage events) — that typically takes a week to test.
- If Stratus wants an enhanced listing (screenshots + short demo), please add that to the MAP under "content" so we can plan capture.

I’ll join the 10:00 ET sync tomorrow.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole

Hi all — copying our partner-ops intake link and assigning our onboarding specialist for the AWS listing.

- AWS intake form: https://aws-partners.example/onboarding/stratus
- Onboarding specialist: Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@aws-partner.io> — he’ll reach out with required artifacts and the DocuSign for the reseller addendum.

We’re comfortable with the timeline; our typical critique window is ~5 business days after you submit the intake. If you submit the intake by 2028-06-21 we can meet the proposed publish date.

Regards,
Rajiv Menon
Senior Partner Ops | AWS Partner Network
